findings.note: Wachsmann is the patron of HB 1170, Elections; conduct of election; provisional voting procedures; type of identification to be noted. It would require election officers to note on the provisional-ballot envelope the specific type of identification the voter showed, instead of only whether ID was shown. History: subcommittee failed to recommend reporting 3-Y 5-N on 2024-01-22; left in Privileges and Elections 2024-02-13.
